title: Add the no-argument validate:structure run to the overlay gates for docs/standard changes
body:
## Summary
None of the overlay's three gates validates the six built-in lens manifests this context owns: a schema-invalid manifest passes typecheck, check:lens-health and validate:structure(kettle) alike.

## Description
.claude/scan-sweep/config.md:16-21 gates every round on typecheck and check:lens-health, and runs validate:structure only with the Kettle map + events as arguments. The built-in manifests are schema-validated only by the no-argument run (scripts/validate-structure.mjs:355-356, `builtinRun`), which no gate invokes; the Kettle map carries copies of the manifests, so drift in docs/standard/lenses/*.json is invisible until a catalog copy is refreshed. com.kettle.cost.json (lenses-custom) is validated by no run at all. Fixed: the overlay's conditional gate list gains `npm run validate:structure` (no args) and `node scripts/validate-structure.mjs docs/standard/lenses-custom/com.kettle.cost.json` 'when docs/standard or src/lib/standard change'.

## Flow
- seed: set docs/standard/lenses/security.json presentation.glyph to 'padlok'
- run the overlay gates: typecheck 0, check:lens-health 0, validate:structure -- kettle 0 (all green)
- run `npm run validate:structure`: exit 1, 'presentation.glyph: must be one of ... (got "padlok")'
- add the line to the overlay; the seed now fails the round

## Expected impact
Rounds that touch the standard's manifests get a gate that sees them. Nothing can break; it adds one ~1 s run.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the gate set covers the artefacts the context owns
Before: 0 of 7 manifest files validated by any overlay gate (seed went green on all 3)
After: 7 of 7 (6 built-ins via the no-arg run, the custom one by path); the same seed exits 1
Method: gate - seeded the violation and read each gate's exit code on the real tree, then reverted
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
seed glyph 'padlok' in docs/standard/lenses/security.json:
  npm run -s typecheck -> 0
  npm run -s check:lens-health -> 0
  npm run -s validate:structure -- src/data/kettle.app-structure.json --events src/data/kettle.events.jsonl -> 0
  npm run -s validate:structure -> 1  'FAIL docs\standard\lenses\security.json ... presentation.glyph: must be one of: bars, set-square, brackets, pulse, padlock, check (got "padlok")'
